fichas.title: Room Acoustics
fichas.summary: Room acoustics depends strongly on the room’s primary structure. Narrow, high rooms with geometrically structured reflecting walls and diffusely reflecting ceilings favor early side reflections. Shape ceilings to direct sound toward the rear and avoid unfavorable concentrations; avoid parallel unstructured surfaces that cause flutter echo. Wall folds can diffuse reflections, and reflective surfaces can compensate for weak side reflections. Podium placement and raised seating influence sound distribution; banked seating promotes uniform direct sound.
